name: Materially-different-anchor D1V frame constructibility screen with conditional incumbent false-accept read (K=4)

mandate_reference.director_mandate_question_downstream: Is a value-only-rotation (D1V) population spanning >=2 credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors constructible such that the anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V) is non-degenerate and M-N-D1V-ANCHORS>=2, either by admitting a materially different anchor population or by a structurally justified instrument change; and if not constructible on this substrate, park the four-anchor Part II route with a decisive positive-control-backed bounded reason?
mandate_reference.route_taken: Route A (materially different anchor population). Route B (instrument reclassification of transport-validator motion as value-caused) is NOT adopted as a primary route: on the inherited frozen evidence the CAL-POS-1 body-derived ETag moves with non-token body regions (per-request nonce / correlation id) and the CAL-POS-3 final_url token is a different token from the body wpLoginToken, so the motion is not caused solely by the rotating value and a reclassification would not be structurally justified. This is preserved as a rejected route in `continuity`.

inherited_established: D1V = STALE AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change, with the frozen definitions in `frozen_definitions` (EXP-GRAPH-37992949248, itself adapted from EXP-GRAPH-37978902447).

The anchor-clustered bootstrap estimator is certified capable of non-degenerate interior bounds (GATE F PASS: SYN-ESTIMATOR-2ANCHOR LOW=1/3, UB97=1/2; SYN-ESTIMATOR-1ANCHOR -> null; SYN-ESTIMATOR-HOMOGENEOUS -> zero-width [1/2,1/2]); the estimator is not the source of the Part II degeneracy.

The incumbent value-blind guard (B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY) on a D1V trial REUSEs unless CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires; B-VALUE-AWARE always ABSTAINs on a D1V trial (CH-PRECOND-BINDING fires because the value rotated).

Inherited four pinned anchors cannot power the read: M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1 (only CAL-POS-2); CAL-POS-1 blocker BODY_DERIVED_ETAG, CAL-POS-3 blocker TOKEN_BEARING_FINAL_URL, CAL-POS-4 blocker NO_FIELD; M-TRANSPORT-COUPLING-STABILITY=UNCHANGED on all four anchors across two capture dates.
C-FRESHNESS is at effective registry status EXPERIMENTAL; no packet has advanced or regressed it since EXP-GRAPH-37978902447.
inherited_rejected: REJECTED (bounded): that the four pinned anchors under the frozen transport signature can yield a D1V population spanning >=2 anchors.
REJECTED: that the single-anchor degeneracy is an estimator defect.
inherited_unknown: Whether a D1V population spanning >=2 anchors is constructible at all on the credential-free, server-rendered, no-JS GET-only substrate (THIS EXPERIMENT).
Whether the incumbent false-accept differential is non-degenerate and >0 (INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED) or not (INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND) on any such population.
do_not_assume: Do not assume transport signatures are time-stable for any platform that ever issues body-derived validators; EXECUTE must re-verify liveness and blockers at runtime under the frozen predicates.

Do not import the inherited single-anchor point estimate M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V=1.0 / M-FA-INCUMBENT-D1V=1.0 / M-FA-VALUEAWARE-D1V=0.0 as a result; those are descriptive single-anchor values with null bounds.
Do not assume the mandate's Route B is open: it is rejected on inherited frozen evidence for CAL-POS-1 and CAL-POS-3 (see mandate_reference.route_taken).
Do not treat a DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V(-DEGENERATE) branch as a falsification of C-FRESHNESS or of the value-awareness mechanism.

question: On a pre-registered, materially different population of credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript, GET-only anchors, does there exist a value-only-rotation (D1V) frame spanning >=2 anchors whose anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW) is non-degenerate (LOW < UB97, decision set {REUSE,ABSTAIN} realized), thereby licensing INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED (CH-PRECOND-BINDING necessary) or INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND (value-aware channel deletable); or is no such frame constructible on this substrate, so the four-anchor Part II route must be parked with a decisive positive-control-backed bounded reason?
hypothesis: A non-degenerate >=2-anchor D1V frame exists on the pre-registered population iff at least one D1V-bearing anchor realizes CH-POSTCOND-SEM on at least one D1V trial (equivalently: the per-trial paired differential is not identically 1 across D1V trials), because on D1V trials CH-STRUCT-SIG and CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR are false by definition and B-VALUE-AWARE always ABSTAINs. If every D1V trial is postcond-silent, the incumbent REUSE decision set is {REUSE}, the differential is identically 1, the anchor-clustered interval collapses to [1,1], and the sole outcome is a pre-declared NO-READ (power) branch.
falsifier: This experiment's structural certificate is falsified if a >=2-anchor D1V frame with per-anchor incumbent REUSE-rate heterogeneity (or within-anchor postcond variation) fails to yield LOW < UB97 under the frozen estimator, or if the frozen estimator produces a non-degenerate interval on a provably homogeneous D1V population. The frame-constructibility hypothesis is falsified if the pre-registered screen finds zero D1V trials on every candidate.

candidate_population.role: Materially different from the inherited WMF-family pinned anchors (CAL-POS-1..4 are NOT refetched). Selection favors credential-free, server-rendered, no-JS GET-only form pages whose session-scoped token fields are minted server-side and whose transport validators are structurally independent of the rotating value, plus a spread of platform families to sample in-list field-name-set stability.
candidate_population.selection_rule: Fixed pre-registered list below (ids stable for EXECUTE/AUDIT); no outcome-dependent additions. A candidate may be dropped only by the pre-declared unreachability/blocker rules (UNREACHABLE, NO_FIELD, SSO_REDIRECT), never to improve the read. Anchors whose in-list token fields hold invariant values (RECOVERED_INVARIANT, FRESH-only trials) are RETAINED as population members: the frozen channel non-degeneracy rule runs over all trials, so FRESH trials are required for the READ branch; retained value-bearing non-D1V anchors inform degeneracy attribution (M-N-D1V-BLOCKED-ANCHORS).

anchors.structural_rationale: MediaWiki does not emit ETag and sends Cache-Control no-cache/no-store; the wpEditToken/wpCreateaccountToken fields are server-minted per session, so no transport validator is expected to depend on the value.
Second independent MediaWiki deployment (different operator) for cross-anchor independence.
Fourth MediaWiki deployment; probes whether field-name sets vary with extensions/skins.
Gitea login form carries _csrf and possibly conditional fields; screened for D1V and for field-name-set variation.
Rails-family pages are known to issue body-derived weak ETags on some deployments; expected blocker documents transport-value coupling on a third platform family.
Expected SSO redirect to an external OIDC portal; documents NO_FIELD/SSO blocker.
Registration may reject anonymous clients; documents UNREACHABLE blocker.
NodeBB register form carries a csrf token and possibly conditional fields.
Discourse signup is server-rendered for anonymous GET with a session token; Discord-independent of the inherited meta.discourse.org anchor.
Redmine register carries authenticity_token; screened for D1V and field-name-set variation.
Moodle signup form carries sesskey/logintoken-style fields; screened for D1V and variation.
Bugzilla account creation carries a token field; screened for D1V and variation.

negative_control_anchor.role: network reachability + NO_FIELD negative control (no in-list token fields)

capture_protocol.design: K=4 fresh cookieless GET-only sessions per candidate, fresh empty CookieJar per (anchor, session), no JavaScript execution, no submissions, no credentials, stdlib HTTP only.
capture_protocol.network_control: One iana.org GET before and after the screen; a 403/redirect from a candidate is a transport-level observation, never a network failure.
per_session_record: raw body retained for the D1V-bearing frame and blockers
extraction path A and path B in-list records with byte-exact values and states
exclusion_rules: UNREACHABLE: fewer than 3 of 4 sessions return HTTP 200
SSO_REDIRECT/NO_FIELD: recorded with blocker, contributes no trials
unstable-field exclusion inherited from the frozen population builder
capture_protocol.no_refetch: The inherited pinned anchors CAL-POS-1..4 are NOT refetched (mandate exclusion).

frozen_definitions.label: STALE iff live value != recorded value byte-exact (CH-PRECOND-BINDING analogue).
frozen_definitions.structural_change: structure_signature(recorded) != structure_signature(current); structure_signature = (type_class, form_action, form_method, tuple(form_input_names)).
frozen_definitions.transport_change: transport_signature(recorded) != transport_signature(current); transport_signature = (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url).
frozen_definitions.postcond_change: session in-list field-name set differs between recorded and current session (CH-POSTCOND-SEM).
frozen_definitions.endpoint_change: per-instance form_action differs (recorded vs current extraction).
frozen_definitions.D1V: label == STALE AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change (postcond_change allowed).
frozen_definitions.identity_preserved: These are the inherited frozen definitions, unchanged. No guard code and no definition is modified; the four frozen guard variants and the shared estimator are reused.

estimator_binding.resampling_unit: anchors with replacement over D1V-bearing anchors (pooled-cluster pooling)
estimator_binding.degenerate_semantics: n_anchors<2 -> LOW=UB97=null; LOW==UB97 -> zero-width degenerate; non-degenerate requires LOW<UB97.

certificate.theorem: On any D1V trial, CH-STRUCT-SIG and CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR are false by the frozen D1V definition, and CH-PRECOND-BINDING is true (the value is STALE), so B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY = REUSE iff CH-POSTCOND-SEM is false, and B-VALUE-AWARE = ABSTAIN. Hence the paired per-trial differential (incumbent REUSE minus value-aware REUSE) equals the postcond-silence indicator: 1 if CH-POSTCOND-SEM is false, 0 if true.
certificate.corollary: The anchor-clustered bootstrap interval is non-degenerate (LOW<UB97) iff the realized per-trial differential is not constant across the resampled anchor clusters, equivalently iff CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires on at least one D1V trial (so the incumbent D1V decision set is {REUSE,ABSTAIN}) and the per-anchor incumbent REUSE rates are not identical. If every D1V trial is postcond-silent the decision set is {REUSE}, the differential is identically 1, and the interval collapses to [1,1] (zero-width).

reachable_frame_arithmetic.example: 2 D1V-bearing anchors, K=4 sessions, 6 D1V pairs per anchor; anchor A all postcond-silent (incumbent REUSE 6/6, per-trial differential 1), anchor B postcond-fire on 2/6 pairs (incumbent REUSE 4/6); PLUS at least one FRESH trial anywhere in the realized population so that CH-PRECOND-BINDING both fires and not-fires (the frozen channel non-degeneracy rule is evaluated over the FULL trial set, not only D1V).

frozen_machine_output_at_design_probe.run_on: bound run_experiment.py :: guard_statistics on the synthetic scenarios below (satisfiability probe; no live evidence)

reachable_frame_arithmetic.gate_read: with a value-mixed population the machine outputs INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED (positive width, M-N-D1V=12>=6, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=2>=2, M-N-DECISIONS-D1V=2, diff>=0.10, LOW>0); with an all-STALE population the SAME D1V frame yields DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V because CH-PRECOND-BINDING is constant (nondegenerate=false). FRESH-bearing anchors (RECOVERED_INVARIANT verdict) are therefore informative for the READ branch, not discardable.

degenerate_frame_realization.example: >=2 D1V-bearing anchors, every D1V pair postcond-silent (incumbent REUSE 100%).
degenerate_frame_realization.gate_read: decision set {REUSE} -> below the frozen adequacy floor -> NO-READ (DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V / DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE), never a blindness/necessity result.

certificate.arithmetic_note: The counterexamples above use only the frozen estimator at the frozen binding and the frozen guard decisions; they are satisfiability demonstrations for decision-rule reachability and are NOT observations about the screened anchors. The screened anchors' realized frame is computed ONLY at EXECUTE.

baselines.B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY: REUSE iff none of CH-STRUCT-SIG / CH-TRANSPORT-VALIDATOR / CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires (value-blind incumbent; the guard under evaluation).
baselines.B-VALUE-AWARE: REUSE iff CH-PRECOND-BINDING does not fire (adds byte-exact value binding).
baselines.B-FULL-GUARD: REUSE iff none of the four channels fires.
baselines.B-NO-GUARD-REPLAY: always REUSE (value-less replay, no session binding).
baselines.identity_note: All four are the inherited frozen guard variants, decision set {REUSE, ABSTAIN}; their code is bound in freeze_artifacts and is not modified.

positive_control.PC-ESTIMATOR-NONDEGENERATE: SYN-ESTIMATOR-2ANCHOR at the frozen binding -> LOW=1/3, UB97=1/2, non-degenerate (same bootstrap function as the real read; V16).
positive_control.PC-POSTCOND-CLASSIFIER-SENSITIVITY: SYN-GUARD-POSTCOND: CH-POSTCOND-SEM true, value unchanged -> B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY ABSTAIN, B-VALUE-AWARE REUSE, B-FULL-GUARD ABSTAIN (proves the postcond channel and the differential mechanism can fire).
positive_control.PC-EXTRACTION-CANARY: Both independent extraction paths recover in-list token values byte-identically on every live VALUE-state candidate body and on the retained blocker bodies.
positive_control.PC-CLASSIFIER-SENSITIVITY: The frozen classifier reproduces the inherited parent trial matrix exactly from inherited raw evidence (48 trials) before the screen is read.
positive_control.M-FIXTURE-EMPTY-AGREE: Both paths agree on the empty/invariant fixtures.
positive_control.M-GUARD-FIXTURE-PASS: All SYN-GUARD-* fixtures realize their expected decisions under the frozen guard code.

null_control: NC-ESTIMATOR-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY: SYN-ESTIMATOR-1ANCHOR -> null (n_anchors<2); SYN-ESTIMATOR-HOMOGENEOUS -> zero-width [1/2,1/2] (population-diagnostic, not estimator failure).
NC-POSTCOND-NULL: SYN-GUARD-FRESH / equal in-list field-name sets -> CH-POSTCOND-SEM does NOT fire.
NC-OPEN-GET-ONLY: every screen request carries no Cookie header (fresh empty jar before every request).
NC-CREDENTIAL-FREE: no account creation, no submission, no credentials.
NC-NETWORK-CONTROL: iana.org HTTP 200 before and after the screen, with identical body sha256.
NC-NO-FIELD-ANCHOR: NC-IANA yields no in-list token fields under both extraction paths (negative anchor).
measurement_validity: V01-RAW-THEN-DERIVED: raw per-request records, headers, final_url, body hashes and retained bodies are written first; drift labels and guard decisions are derived from them. RAW EVIDENCE, OBSERVATION, DERIVED MEASUREMENT and INTERPRETATION stay distinct.
V02-SUBSTRATE-REVERIFICATION: EXECUTE re-verifies the network/substrate predicates at runtime rather than assuming inherited liveness.
V03-CLASSIFIER-CONTINUITY: extraction paths A/B and the frozen in-list token-name list are reused unchanged; path A/B pair-set agreement is recorded per session.
V04-TIMING: sessions spaced >=3.0s on one egress path and one capture date; every reported fact is single-date for the screened anchors (no multi-date generalization).
V05-CONTEXTUAL-ROTATION: the experiment does not assert WHY a value rotates, only that it does and that no other channel moves on D1V trials.
V06-TRANSPORT-TIME-VARIABILITY: body-derived-validator issuance can vary by platform and date; blockers are re-measured live, never imported.
V07-SYNTHETIC-BOUNDARY: synthetic fixtures are instrument self-tests only; no synthetic pseudo-anchor enters the scored population and no synthetic number is reported as a real measure.
V08-STANDALONE-DRIVER: the EXECUTE driver may only fetch bytes and call the bound frozen modules; it may not re-implement classification, guard or estimator logic.
V09-POWER-STATEMENT-NOT-NEGATIVE: a NO-READ branch is a pre-declared power/feasibility statement, not a scientific falsification and not a claim-status change.

V10-EMBEDDED-EVIDENCE: per-session headers, final_url, body_sha256, extracted values and per-pair classifications for the constructed D1V frame are embedded verbatim in result.json/derived artifacts so downstream auditors can recompute every drift label.

decision_rule.frame_construction: Build the D1V trial set over the pre-registered population using the frozen definitions and the bound modules; then compute the frozen metrics and the shared estimator at the binding.
decision_rule.rule_binding: The decision rule IS the inherited frozen `run_experiment.py :: guard_statistics` `gate_b_branch` machine (read once GATE F passes). EXECUTE must call that function unchanged; the branch labels below are its exact outputs, not a re-specification.
decision_rule.READ_INCUMBENT_BLIND_CONFIRMED: Trigger when GATE F passes, cluster_precondition_ok fires (M-N-D1V>=6 AND M-N-DECISIONS-D1V>=2 AND M-N-D1V-ANCHORS>=2 AND channels non-degenerate), NOT zero-width (M-D1V-POSITIVE-WIDTH=true, i.e. LOW<UB97), AND M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V>=0.10 AND M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW>0. Consequence: the value-blind incumbent signal set false-accepts on real value-only rotation; CH-PRECOND-BINDING is necessary (bounded to the screened population).
decision_rule.READ_INCUMBENT_NOT_BLIND: Trigger when GATE F passes and the clustered interval is non-degenerate and positive-width, but M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V<0.10 OR M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW<=0. Consequence: the value-aware channel is not materially necessary on this population (bounded negative about necessity, not a C-FRESHNESS falsification).
decision_rule.NO_READ_DATA_INSUFFICIENT_D1V: Trigger when GATE F passes but cluster_precondition_ok fails with M-N-D1V-ANCHORS>=2 (M-N-D1V<6, or M-N-DECISIONS-D1V<2 / identically-REUSE D1V decisions, or channels degenerate). Consequence: park Part II with the per-anchor blocker/transport-change causes and the postcond-homogeneity attribution; product answer for C-FRESHNESS remains UNKNOWN.
decision_rule.NO_READ_DATA_INSUFFICIENT_D1V_DEGENERATE: Trigger when either GATE F fails (degeneracy mode ESTIMATOR_DEGENERATE), or cluster_precondition_ok fails with M-N-D1V-ANCHORS<2, or the clustered interval is zero-width (LOW==UB97, mode ANCHOR_SCARCITY_OTHER). Degeneracy mode attributed to ANCHOR_TRANSPORT_COUPLING (all value-bearing non-D1V anchors transport-blocked) or ANCHOR_SCARCITY_OTHER. Consequence: park Part II with the bounded positive-control-backed reason.
decision_rule.ordering: The frozen machine evaluates in fail-closed order: (1) GATE F fail -> DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE; (2) cluster_precondition_ok fail -> DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V (or -DEGENERATE if n_anchors<2); (3) n_anchors<2 -> -DEGENERATE; (4) zero-width -> -DEGENERATE; (5) else READ (BLIND-CONFIRMED or NOT-BLIND). The READ branches are evaluated before the NO-READ branches, so no branch is shadowed.
decision_rule.branch_reachability_argument: Both the READ and the NO-READ branches are reachable, verified against the bound frozen machine itself (see certificate.reachable_frame_arithmetic.frozen_machine_output_at_design_probe). READ is reachable whenever (i) at least one D1V pair realizes a postcond fire (decision set {REUSE,ABSTAIN}) and (ii) the realized full population is value-mixed, i.e. CH-PRECOND-BINDING both fires (STALE trials) and not-fires (>=1 FRESH trial); concrete arithmetic: 2 anchors, one at 4/6 incumbent REUSE, plus >=1 FRESH trial -> machine output INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED, LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0. NO-READ is reachable when every D1V pair is postcond-silent ([1,1] zero-width or decision set {REUSE}), when the population is all-STALE (PRECOND constant -> nondegenerate=false -> DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V despite positive width), or when fewer than two anchors contribute D1V trials. The freeze does not pre-compute which branch the screened anchors will realize.

metric_registry.M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V: incumbent-minus-value-aware false-accept differential on D1V trials (frozen definition).
metric_registry.M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW: anchor-clustered bootstrap 2.5th percentile of the differential.
metric_registry.M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-UB97: anchor-clustered bootstrap 97.5th percentile of the differential.
metric_registry.M-N-D1V-ANCHORS: number of anchors contributing D1V trials.
metric_registry.M-N-DECISIONS-D1V: number of distinct B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY decisions realized on D1V trials (pinned to the guard under evaluation).
metric_registry.M-N-POSTCOND-DRIFT: number of trials with postcond_change (the decisive heterogeneity count).
metric_registry.M-FA-INCUMBENT-D1V: incumbent REUSE rate on D1V trials.
metric_registry.M-FA-VALUEAWARE-D1V: value-aware REUSE rate on D1V trials.
metric_registry.M-N-D1V-BLOCKED-ANCHORS: count of value-bearing non-D1V anchors with a transport/structural/no-field blocker.
metric_registry.M-CAND-REACHABLE: count of candidates with >=3/4 HTTP 200 sessions.
metric_registry.M-CAND-D1V-ANCHORS: count of candidates contributing >=1 D1V trial (new-screen liveness metric).

PC-POSTCOND-CLASSIFIER-SENSITIVITY.expected: CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires under SYN-GUARD-POSTCOND; incumbent ABSTAIN, value-aware REUSE

PC-EXTRACTION-CANARY.expected: byte-identical value recovery on live VALUE-state bodies

NC-POSTCOND-NULL.expected: CH-POSTCOND-SEM silent when in-list field-name sets are equal

NC-OPEN-GET-ONLY.expected: no Cookie header on any request

NC-NO-FIELD-ANCHOR.expected: NC-IANA yields no in-list token fields

product_consequence_positive: If a non-degenerate read is obtained: INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED supports retaining CH-PRECOND-BINDING (a value-aware freshness channel) in the shipped storage-cache REUSE decision, with a measured incumbent false-accept bound on a multi-anchor credential-free population; INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND would permit consolidating the value-aware channel. Either read materially changes the freshness-guard product decision and gives a bounded, auditable operating point. No automatic promotion to Product Core is implied; only DIRECTOR may act on the read.
product_consequence_negative: If no non-degenerate frame is constructible on this population (NO-READ), then the four-anchor Part II route is PARKed with a measured, positive-control-backed bounded reason; the product answer for C-FRESHNESS remains UNKNOWN; C-FRESHNESS keeps its inherited EXPERIMENTAL status with no change; budget is not spent on a structurally degenerate read; and the decision returns to the Global Research Director to redirect freshness toward a broader-population guard false-accept/calibration measurement or another sub-mechanism.
estimated_cost: One screen: 14 candidates x K=4 sessions = 56 candidate GETs + 2 iana.org controls, under a hard cap of 200 GETs; stdlib-only, no browser, no JS, no credentials; ~10-15 minutes wall-clock at >=3.0s pacing; estimator and fixture controls are local and sub-second.
expected_information_gain: Decisively settles whether a >=2-anchor D1V frame with a non-degenerate incumbent false-accept bound is constructible on a materially different credential-free GET-only population: it either yields the first multi-anchor INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED / INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND read (the missing quantity for freshness economics) or a measured, positive-control-backed PARK of the Part II route with exact per-anchor transport-change causes and the postcond-homogeneity attribution. It also produces the first cross-family map of body-derived transport coupling beyond the inherited WMF evidence.

code_binding.reused_frozen_modules: All classification, guard and estimator semantics come from the inherited frozen parent modules listed in freeze_artifacts, imported unchanged; the EXECUTE driver may only fetch bytes and call them.
code_binding.new_driver: A thin orchestration driver (fetch + record + call bound modules) is written at EXECUTE under the experiment directory; it re-implements no classification, guard or estimator logic (V08). Its exact endpoints and protocol are frozen in this spec.
code_binding.no_product_code: No shipped SPIDER code (src/) is touched.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both a positive/support branch and a decision-changing alternative branch are reachable at the frozen estimator binding, verified against the bound frozen machine itself (run_experiment.py :: guard_statistics on synthetic scenarios; no live evidence). READ (INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED) is reachable whenever at least one D1V pair realizes a postcond fire AND the realized full population is value-mixed (>=1 FRESH trial so CH-PRECOND-BINDING both fires and not-fires): the frozen machine on that construction outputs INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED with LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0, M-N-D1V=12, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=2, M-N-DECISIONS-D1V=2, pooled differential=0.833. NO-READ is reachable when every D1V pair is postcond-silent ([1,1] zero-width, decision set {REUSE}), when the population is all-STALE (PRECOND constant -> nondegenerate=false -> DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V despite positive width), or when fewer than two anchors contribute D1V trials. Thresholds (M-N-D1V>=6, M-N-D1V-ANCHORS>=2, M-N-DECISIONS-D1V>=2, LOW<UB97, differential>=0.10) are arithmetically attainable at K=4/6-pairs-per-anchor; the frozen fail-closed gate ordering leaves no branch shadowed. The freeze does not pre-compute the realized branch.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: The measurement requires only: outbound HTTPS from the runner (inherited, exercised by the parent packet), the Python standard library (no browser, no JS, no credentials), and the inherited frozen modules listed in freeze_artifacts. All exist in-repo and are importable; the estimator/guard fixtures execute locally. No dataset, task bank or writable control must be created during EXECUTE. The only EXECUTE-authored file is a thin orchestration driver that fetches bytes and calls the already-present bound modules; it introduces no unproven capability (HTTP is stdlib-proven and exercised by the parent), only binds the new endpoint list into the existing functions via their module-level anchor/session constants. Candidate liveness is screened at runtime and unreachable candidates are recorded as blockers, not treated as prerequisites whose absence blocks the measurement.

baseline_identifiability.reason: On a D1V trial the incumbent and value-aware arms are structurally distinct: B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY REUSEs iff CH-POSTCOND-SEM is false, while B-VALUE-AWARE ABSTAINs (CH-PRECOND-BINDING fires because the value rotated). The arms are therefore not guaranteed identical, and the paired differential ranges over {0,1} per trial, so a non-degenerate interval is attainable (2-anchor example LOW=2/3, UB97=1.0). No cost metric is used, so no cost dimension is omitted; there is no all-arms-ceiling/floor guarantee.

control_sensitivity.reason: The positive control and the null control can fire and stay null under the same implementation that scores the experiment: PC-ESTIMATOR-NONDEGENERATE (same bootstrap function, LOW=1/3, UB97=1/2) and PC-POSTCOND-CLASSIFIER-SENSITIVITY (postcond fires under SYN-GUARD-POSTCOND) versus NC-ESTIMATOR-CONTROL-SENSITIVITY (1-anchor null; homogeneous zero-width) and NC-POSTCOND-NULL (no fire on equal field sets). These were executed as local design-time satisfiability probes and their values are recorded in control_registry.

treatment_liveness.reason: This is a measurement/constructibility experiment in the graph lane with no SPIDER product-mechanism treatment arm; the compared objects are the four inherited frozen guard baselines over a naturally occurring drift population, and no shipped SPIDER code is executed. There is no treatment whose executability could fail before the expensive arm.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Every mutable local interpretation dependency is bound by hash: the inherited frozen guard, estimator, extraction, neutral-detector and population/statistics code that defines the labels, channels and bootstrap. Native remote Web responses cannot be frozen; their exact endpoints and the sampling protocol are frozen in candidate_population and capture_protocol. The EXECUTE orchestration driver re-implements no semantics (V08) and only calls these bound modules.

scope_boundaries: Only spec.json and prereg.md are written at DESIGN.
CAL-POS-1..4 are not refetched; inherited evidence is read-only.
